name: MorphGate custom rules
description: MorphGate (Pro and above): keep Cloudflare bot and security-level challenges off /__mg/*. Rate limiting rules still apply (the /__mg/ flood rule must not be skipped). Template: adapters/cloudflare/README.md.

rules.description: MorphGate: /__mg/* skips SBFM, Browser Integrity Check and Security Level. Does NOT skip http_ratelimit, so a rate limiting rule against POST /__mg/ floods keeps working.
